title: The steps, nobody
logline: Last Bell, private, sixteen days before he returns as a back: the school steps from across the road at 3:05, the doors opening, the kids, and the far sidewalk empty where he'd stand. The page draws the absence in the usual place.

panels.composition: The high school at the last bell from across the road, doors open, students pouring toward the beach road, and the near sidewalk — the strip's usual place — empty, a section of curb and nothing.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small-town high school at the last bell seen from across the road with students pouring out toward a beach and the near sidewalk conspicuously empty, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
